# Claude Daily Memory

> Privacy-first, local-first long-term memory for Claude Code with deterministic daily digests, fail-closed secret scanning, optional Google Drive export, and NotebookLM Drive-source support.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/geft2/claude-daily-memory
Documentation: https://github.com/geft2/claude-daily-memory#readme
Security policy: https://github.com/geft2/claude-daily-memory/security/policy
License: Apache-2.0

## Core facts

- The software does not read raw Claude Code transcripts.
- It collects allowlisted lifecycle metadata from multiple terminals and projects.
- It includes only curated Markdown artifacts in daily memory.
- It scans each artifact and the final digest for secrets before networking.
- It fails closed when scanning or parsing is uncertain.
- Google export uses the official Drive and Docs APIs with the `drive.file` scope.
- Refresh tokens must be stored in an operating-system Secret Service.
- NotebookLM integration uses a normal Google Drive source, not private APIs or browser cookies.
- Gmail content is excluded from daily memory.
- Gmail cleanup rules support reversible moves to Trash only; permanent deletion is unsupported.
- Gemini integration accepts explicit text only and is not part of automatic daily export.

## Important files

- `src/claude_daily_memory/hooks.py`: privacy-preserving Claude Code hook
- `src/claude_daily_memory/digest.py`: deterministic local digest builder
- `src/claude_daily_memory/sanitize.py`: fail-closed secret scanner
- `src/claude_daily_memory/google_drive.py`: official Drive and Docs export
- `src/claude_daily_memory/gmail_rules.py`: exact reversible cleanup decisions
- `SECURITY.md`: private vulnerability reporting instructions
